_README: Development fixture for the local Convex deployment. Loaded by `bun run seed:dev`.
This file is CONTENT, not code - regenerate it freely, by hand or with a model, whenever the screens need a different shape of data.

Numbers are synthetic on purpose: every one sits in a reserved-looking block so a fixture can never collide with a number a real person holds. They are still valid Indian mobile format, so normalisation and validation behave exactly as they do in production.
`daysAgo` is relative, so a reseed always produces an inbox that looks current. Fractions are allowed - 0.25 is six hours ago.
`leadStatus` is one of: new, contacted, interested, enrolled, lost.
`note` lands on the activity record, never on the Person, because staff notes must not sit on a row that could be exported.
None of this reaches production: convex/devSeed.ts refuses any deployment that is not local.
